overview: TCP reliable, connection-oriented, byte-stream transport protocol hai. GATE me: 3-way handshake (seq/ack numbers), connection termination (FIN), sequence-number wraparound/window scale calculations, timeout/RTT, aur conceptual statements.
whyItMatters: 20 PYQs, 2004-2026; handshake aur seq-number/window calculations recent saalon me MSQ/NAT ke roop me.
coreConcept: TCP har BYTE ko sequence number deta hai. Connection 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK) se khulta hai; ACK number = next expected byte.
hinglishExplanation: Client SYN(seq=x) bhejta hai, server SYN+ACK(seq=y, ack=x+1) deta hai, client ACK(ack=y+1) bhejta hai. SYN aur FIN ek sequence number consume karte hain. Data me ACK = last received byte + 1. Sequence number ka wrap-around tab tak safe hona chahiye jab tak purana segment network me jinda ho (MSL).
formalDefinition: Sequence space 2^32 bytes; window scale option se 16-bit window ko 2^14 tak scale kiya jaata hai.
importantProperties: TCP full duplex, byte-stream, in-order, reliable; guaranteed minimum rate NAHI deta.
Sequence number bytes ko assign hota hai, segments ko nahi.
3-way handshake: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK; SYN ek seq number khaata hai.
Termination: FIN se (4-way); FIN bhi ek seq number khaata hai; half-close possible.
TCP selective acknowledgement (SACK) option support karta hai.
Server crash ke baad naya connection se aane wale segments par RST milta hai.
Wraparound: 2^n sequence numbers >= rate x (MSL etc.) se n nikalo.
Window scale ki zaroorat: bandwidth x RTT (BDP) > 2^16 bytes.
Timeout RTT ke estimate se adapt hota hai (fixed nahi).
Initial sequence number ToD clock se: same seq reuse rokne ke liye.

formulas.ackNum: ack = next expected byte = last received + 1

keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Data segment: seq = first byte number, next seq = seq + length.
SYN/FIN consume 1 seq number, ACK-only nahi.
commonPitfalls: Segment count ko seq number ki jagah lena.
standardTechniques: Handshake diagram banao, har packet ka seq/ack likho.
Wraparound: time = 2^n bytes / (rate in bytes/sec) > MSL.
BDP nikaalke window scale ki need check karo.
